FEAT-3-S132.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Query Construction and Recruiting Filter Enforcement
FEAT-3-S132.description: Implement core logic to construct ClinicalTrials.gov API queries with mandatory RECRUITING status filter, condition keyword handling, and location parameterization.

FEAT-3-S133.title: Trial Location Extraction and Normalization
FEAT-3-S133.description: Extract trial site locations from API response and normalize into structured format (city, state, coordinates) for downstream distance calculations.

FEAT-3-S134.title: Travel Distance and Duration Computation via Google Routes
FEAT-3-S134.description: Integrate Google Routes API to compute travel distance and duration from user location to each trial site, including fallback handling for missing or invalid coordinates.

FEAT-3-S135.title: Clinical Trial Result Formatting and Ranking
FEAT-3-S135.description: Format enriched trial results into response-ready structure including title, phase, status, site locations, and travel metrics; apply basic ranking (e.g., nearest first).
